$comment: The Bundu floor as data: https://standards.bundu.org/bundu-floor/. Every length is in CSS pixels. Each entry gives its value, the recommended value it was taken from, and where that recommendation comes from. A spacing entry has a default value (the floor at default density) and, where it has one, a dense value (the absolute floor). A component may go larger than a value, never smaller. Owner's canonical values, 2026-11-19. CC0.
name: The Bundu floor

numberRule.allowed: Every length is a multiple of 3, a multiple of 7, or a prime.
numberRule.direction: Take the nearest allowed value at or above the recommended value, never below it.
numberRule.exceptions: The phone page edge takes the general rule, not the seven: 17, the next allowed value at or above 16 (owner, 2026-11-19).

tiers.touch: Every screen that is not the fine-pointer tier: a coarse pointer, or a window under 64rem.
tiers.finePointer: (pointer: fine) and (hover: hover) and (min-width: 64rem) and (not (any-pointer: coarse))

touch.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced), AAA; Apple HIG 44 pt

large.source: Mzizi spacing-control-lg and touch-target-sm, 40 before 2026-11-19; 41 is prime, the nearest allowed value at or above 40

bodyTouch.source: Apple HIG default body size, 17 pt

caption.source: The Bundu floor, unchanged on 2026-11-19; the minimum for captions and secondary labels

padding.source: A compact status pill; Material 3 large badge 4 dp
Material 3 chip side padding (8 dp compact)
Material 3 button side padding (12 dp dense); buttons

between.source: Material 3 spacing between targets; the same in both modes

labelToField.source: Material 3 label to field, 4 dp; owner confirmed 2026-11-19

padding.source: Material 3 card padding (12 dp list item)

titleToBody.source: Title to body, the Material 3 4 dp step; the same in both modes

betweenItems.source: Material 3 list item spacing; the card gap; owner confirmed 2026-11-19

edge.source: Apple layout margin 16 pt; Material 3 compact window margin 16 dp. No dense step.

edgeWide.source: Material 3 medium and expanded window margins, 24 dp; dense from the 16 to 24 dp range

density.default: Reading, forms, onboarding, payments, and anything someone does once and must get right.
density.dense: Tables, data views, toolbars, filter rows, status pills, and lists people scan.
density.hitArea: Dense controls keep the full hit area: 45 px on touch and 24 px on a fine pointer.
